issue_context.title: Shelly CoaP listener ignores the "Network Adapter" homeassistant setting (and thus may not receive multicast traffic)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I'm running a setup where my homeassistant instance has multiple interfaces.
In this setup, only the 2nd network interface will receive multicast traffic
In Settings->System->Network->Network Adapter, I have selected my 2nd interface (net1) as the one to be used by integrations.

However, looking at the output of netstat -g (multicast group membership), the shelly integration isn't taking note of this:

```
# netstat -gn
IPv6/IPv4 Group Memberships
Interface       RefCnt Group
--------------- ------ ---------------------
lo              1      224.0.0.1
eth0            1      224.0.1.187                            <------ CoIoT on wrong interface
eth0            1      224.0.0.1
net1            5      239.255.255.250                   <------ SSDP on correct interface
net1            1      224.0.0.251                            <------ MDNS on correct interface
net1            1      224.0.0.1
lo              1      ff02::1
lo              1      ff01::1
eth0            1      ff02::1:ff77:2e81
eth0            1      ff02::1:fff5:6e28
eth0            1      ff02::1
eth0            1      ff01::1
net1            5      ff02::c                                    <------ SSDP on correct interface
net1            1      ff02::fb                                  <------ MDNS on correct interface
net1            3      ff02::1:ff8e:57e7
net1            1      ff02::1
net1            1      ff01::1
```

As a result, I'm not getting multicast CoIoT messages delivered to HA.



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.8.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

shelly
